result.answer:
## Answer: Yes — for this second claim you must pay the ¥12,000 assessment fee again.

**Why:** Per the Claims FAQ (page: `/claims/faq/`, "Fee waivers" section):

> "Claimants with two or more approved claims from separate incidents within any rolling 12-month period are exempt from the ¥12,000 assessment fee... The waiver counts approved claims only. Refused, withdrawn and pending claims do not count toward the two-claim threshold."

This is confirmed on the Fee Schedule page (`/claims/fees/`):
> "The fee is waived entirely for repeat claimants — see fee waivers in the FAQ."

**Applying this to your situation:** You currently have only **one** approved claim (the March incident). The claim you are about to file for the incident three weeks ago is not yet approved — it's pending. The waiver requires **two or more already-approved** claims from separate incidents inside a rolling 12-month window before it kicks in. A pending claim doesn't count toward that threshold.

So for the claim you're filing now, the ¥12,000 assessment fee is still payable at lodgement.

**Looking ahead:** If this second claim is approved, you will then have two approved claims (March and this one) within a 12-month rolling window. If a *third* kaiju incident affected your bakery within that same 12-month window, that third claim would qualify for the automatic fee waiver, since it would be your second-or-later approved claim from a separate incident in the period — no separate application needed, per the FAQ ("The waiver is applied automatically at lodgement").

Also worth noting from the Fee Schedule: the fee is refunded in full if the final award on a claim exceeds ¥1,000,000, regardless of waiver status — so even if you pay it now, you could get it back that way depending on the assessed damage.
